requirement.en: During your Main Phase that you Normal or Special Summoned this card, send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Neither player takes battle damage from battles involving this card until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, you can add 1 Fairy Type Union monster or 1 "Protection of Arthenée" from your Graveyard to your hand.
